fair.title: Claude Cowork, fairly
fair.body: Claude Cowork is Anthropic’s assistant for getting work done. It works through tasks of several steps in the folders and tools you choose, shows each step as it goes, and keeps going when you close your laptop. It comes with paid Claude plans and runs on Claude. Since September 2026, Anthropic has been folding it into the Claude app itself, on Pro, Max and Ultra first.
table.rows: In a browser tab, on any recent computer, phone included.
The Claude desktop app, now rolling out on the web and phones too; a task keeps running in Anthropic’s cloud.
What it takes on your computer
Nothing to install: a web page, kept to work offline. The AI on this computer, if you want it, downloads once (3.1 GB).
The Claude desktop app, and a virtual machine on your computer where code runs. On Linux, Anthropic asks for about 25 GB of free space for it.
The files you give it, inside the browser’s fence. A real folder on your computer in Chrome and Edge.
The folders and tools you choose; deleting anything needs your approval.
Any, Claude included: on this computer, a free one, your key, your plan.
Claude, from Anthropic or through your company’s cloud: Amazon Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry.
The AI you choose. With the AI on this computer, nobody.
Anthropic. Used to train Claude if you allow it in its privacy settings, or if a conversation is flagged for a safety review.
{name} is free; the AI may not be. Your Claude plan works too.
Paid Claude plans, from Pro at $20 a month, or $17 a month billed yearly. Cowork uses up a plan’s allowance faster than chat does.
Yes, MIT. About 40,000 lines anyone can read.
A folder IT serves from its own address, behind its gateway and sign-in.
Claude’s Team and Enterprise plans, with access, spending and tools set by admins.
Plain files and backups. Claude’s export comes in.
Claude’s data export, from Settings › Privacy, its link sent by email.
cloud.title: On your company’s cloud
cloud.why: A company that reaches Claude through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud or Microsoft Foundry runs Claude Cowork in a mode Anthropic calls 3P, for third-party: no sharing between users, no web, no phones, and Anthropic says its architecture can’t bring them there. With {name}, people still work together.
cloud.rows: Share a task, a document or a whole project with colleagues, or by a link, and work on it together, each answered by their own AI. Sealed end to end, through your organisation’s own relay.
No sharing between users: one of the differences Anthropic says it can’t bring to this mode.
Yes: a browser tab is enough, phone included.
No: neither claude.ai on the web nor the mobile app.
{name} works while its tab is open.
No: its sessions stay on the computer, which must stay awake. A scheduled task missed while it sleeps runs when it wakes.
better.title: Where Claude Cowork does better
better.items: One company’s app and AI, made to work together: sign in and start. {name} asks you to choose an AI first.
It keeps working when you close your laptop, and runs tasks on a schedule unattended, except on your company’s cloud. {name} works while it is open.
Plugins that bring skills and connectors in one install, and a company’s own private marketplace of them.
It works on folders where they sit on your computer. {name} does that in Chrome and Edge; in other browsers, on the files you give it.

both.cards: Pro or Max: install Claude Code on this computer and sign in, then paste This computer’s line once.
In Claude: Settings › Privacy › Export data. Drop the file in {name}: every conversation comes in, nothing twice.
Payslips and medical letters with the AI on this computer; the rest with Claude.
catch.items: {name} is free; the AI behind it may not be.
Your Claude plan needs Claude Code on this computer and This computer’s line: a technical step, once.
The AI on this computer needs 12 GB of memory and a recent graphics chip. Not on phones.
Your work lives in this browser. Clear its data without a backup and it’s gone.
faq.items: Is there a free, open-source Claude Cowork alternative?
{name} is free and MIT. It works on your files with any AI, and the AI on this computer costs nothing.
Can it use a local AI?
Yes: the one {name} downloads to this computer, or yours in Ollama or LM Studio.
Yes, Pro or Max, on a computer where Claude Code is installed and signed in.
No. Claude Code is for writing software; {name} is for everyday work on files. {name} uses Claude Code only as the way to your Claude plan.
Is Claude Cowork still a separate app?
Less and less: since September 2026 Anthropic has been folding Cowork into the Claude app, so the same work can start from any conversation, on Pro, Max and Ultra first.
